Station Notes - Mendon 
 
 
03/12/2023: Station Relocation:                                          [1015] 
 
            - station relocated about 465-ft south of previous location: 
                - reinstalled soil sensors* 
                - tipping-bucket rain gauge now mounted on leaf  
                  wetness post (unable to use original post) 
                - checked leaf wetness sensor [standard mount]** 
                - checked pyranometer (unable to level, but data ok) 
                - checked battery (13.5V) 
                - checked solar panel (16V) 
 
                * soil moisture sensors were deployed horizontally at 2"  
                  and 4"... corrected to vertical at 0-12" and 12-24" 
 
               ** site does not include a canopy sensor  
 
 
03/08/2023: Station Maintenance:                                         [1255] 
 
            - routine site maintenance, including: 
                - checked anemometer (bearings need replacement) 
                - checked leaf wetness sensors (good)** 
                - checked soil sensor cables (good) 
                - checked solar panel (good) 
                - checked tipping-bucket rain gauge (reinstalled)* 
                - checked wind vane (properly aligned) 
                - checked /. cleaned enclosure 
 
                * rain gauge was on the ground... may need to check / remove earlier data 
               ** site does not include a canopy sensor

11/19/2007: Station Maintenance (jb): 
 
            - Loaded MAWN Program:  MAWN_ABCW   (3-hr power cycle)  [12:35] 
 
 
09/17/2007: Data Quality (jb): 
 
            - Recent troubles with the datalogger at Mendon introduced gaps 
              of missing data as well as faulty data records.   To correct 
              the faulty data, entries associated with the following times 
              have been removed from the MAWN database: 
 
                 09/05 (d=248):  1005, 1135 
                 09/08 (d=251):  1305, 1310 
                 09/10 (d=253):  2205, 2210 
                 09/12 (d=255):  1635 
                 09/13 (d=256):  2400   (daily data only) 
                 09/16 (d=259):  1845 
 
 
09/16/2007: Station Maintenance: (bn): 
 
            - Datalogger replaced (18;45) 
 
 
08/17/2007: Station Maintenance: (sm): 
 
            - Site visit seemed to indicate that for some unknown reason, 
              the MAWN program was erased from the datalogger.  Power to 
              the modem/logger was reestablished and the logger program 
              (ABCS) was reloaded. 
 
            - Due to the outage, it appears data was lost for the following 
              time period: 
 
                 08/16/07 (day=228) 07:05  -  08/17/07 (day=229) 13:45 
 
 
08/16/2007: Communication Outage: 
 
            - Currently experiencing trouble with communications  
              to the Mendon station.  Unable to connect since  
              7:00am on Thu. 08/16.   Hope to troubleshoot and 
              correct on Mon. 08/20.
